decisions.reason: Assigning image spelling checks to the image-generation phase does not change the requirement to begin image coverage with chapter 1 or its book-specific exception.

The phase assignment for image spelling checks does not change the NASM CPT target file or the required Heading 2 image placement; the checking behavior remains independently represented by the source Requirement.
The source decision does not change the Ontario book's image-placement requirement. It assigns a separate image-quality check to the image-generation phase.
The proofreading state does not currently include image checking, so stating that image checking occurs outside proofreading requires no update or removal from this Requirement.
The CHPN proofreading Requirement contains no image-review obligation, and its proofreading target remains unchanged.
The Florida real estate proofreading Requirement contains no image-checking state to remove or modify.
The M1 proofreading obligation remains valid unchanged and does not currently include image checking.
The study-guide content and formatting rules are unrelated to generated-image checking; the retrieval match is incidental.
Question-spacing correction is independent of generated-image spelling checks and remains unchanged.
